name: security-review-packet
description: Draft the packet security and compliance need before they sign off on an AI system: inventory of models, vendors, data stores, routes, agent tools, MCP servers, IaC and dependencies from the repo, then a cited system overview, data flow, data classification, threat review and open questions, with an optional SOC 2 / NIST AI RMF / ISO 42001 / OWASP LLM coverage map.
